items.title: 弧形阶梯
items.description: 拍摄于佛山和美术馆，黑色阶梯沿清水混凝土墙面舒展，弧形扶手把上下楼层连成流畅线条。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed at He Art Museum in Foshan, where dark steps sweep along exposed concrete walls and a curved handrail links the levels in one fluid line.

items.title: 中庭里的交错曲线
items.description: 拍摄于佛山和美术馆，深浅相间的弧形装置在清水混凝土中庭与环形光带之间交错。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed at He Art Museum in Foshan, where dark and pale sculptural curves cross through the exposed-concrete atrium beneath rings of light.

items.title: 信义巷里的台北101
items.titleEn: Taipei 101 at the End of an Alley in Xinyi
items.description: 拍摄于台北信义区，老公寓与铁窗围出的狭窄巷道正对台北101，新旧城市尺度在晴空下叠在一起。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed in Taipei's Xinyi District, where a narrow lane framed by aging apartments and metal window grilles opens directly toward Taipei 101, layering old and new city scales beneath a clear sky.

items.title: 雨夜里的饶河街夜市
items.titleEn: Raohe Night Market in the Rain
items.description: 拍摄于台北饶河街观光夜市，雨伞下的人群穿过灯火通明的牌楼，湿润路面映出摊档与招牌的色彩。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed at Raohe Street Night Market in Taipei, where crowds under umbrellas pass beneath the illuminated gate and wet pavement reflects the colors of stalls and signs.

items.title: 雨幕中的光华街口
items.titleEn: Traffic Through Guanghua in the Rain
items.description: 拍摄于台北光华商圈，慢门让驶过路口的车辆化成一片白色雨幕，店铺灯光从后方透出。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed in Taipei's Guanghua district, where a long exposure turns passing traffic into a pale veil of rain with shop lights glowing behind it.

items.title: 光华商圈的雨色
items.description: 拍摄于台北光华商圈，雨水铺亮整条街面，密集的电子商店招牌与车灯倒影沿道路向远处延伸。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed in Taipei's Guanghua district, where rain glosses the street and reflections from electronics signs and traffic lights stretch into the distance.

items.title: 忠孝新生站的晚高峰
items.description: 拍摄于台北捷运忠孝新生站，列车开门后乘客汇入扶梯口，站台在傍晚通勤时段显得格外紧凑。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed at Zhongxiao Xinsheng Station on the Taipei Metro, where passengers stream toward the escalators after a train opens during the evening rush.

items.title: 开往新店的捷运
items.description: 拍摄于台北捷运车厢，开往新店的提示亮在车门上方，空着的吊环与站台灯光组成安静一刻。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed inside a Taipei Metro carriage, where the sign points toward Xindian and empty hand straps hang above the open doors and platform lights.

items.title: 台北车站的时刻表
items.titleEn: Departure Boards at Taipei Main Station
items.description: 拍摄于台北车站，红绿文字的列车时刻表悬在售票窗口上方，旅客在大厅里确认下一段行程。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed at Taipei Main Station, where red-and-green departure boards hang above the ticket windows as travelers check the next leg of their journeys.

items.title: 松山窗前的台北101
items.description: 拍摄于台北松山，从高处越过城区望向台北101，信义区楼群在盛夏云层与蓝天之间展开。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed from above in Taipei's Songshan district, looking across the city toward Taipei 101 as the Xinyi skyline rises beneath summer clouds and blue sky.

items.title: 松山夜望台北101
items.description: 拍摄于台北松山，亮起绿色灯光的台北101从信义区楼群后方升起，湿润夜色压低了城市天际线。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed from Songshan in Taipei, where Taipei 101 glows green above the Xinyi skyline beneath a damp, low night sky.

items.title: 野柳女王头
items.description: 拍摄于新北野柳地质公园，女王头独立在海岸岩台上，蜂窝状纹理在阴云与海面之间格外清晰。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed at Yehliu Geopark in New Taipei, where the Queen's Head stands alone on the coastal rock platform, its honeycombed texture distinct against the overcast sea.

items.title: 阴天下的野柳海岸
items.description: 拍摄于新北野柳地质公园，蕈状岩与蜂窝岩散布在海边平台，低垂云层把远山与海面压成冷静色调。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed at Yehliu Geopark in New Taipei, where mushroom and honeycomb rocks spread across the shore beneath low clouds that mute the distant hills and sea.

items.title: 山城九份
items.description: 拍摄于新北九份，层层住宅沿山坡密集展开，寺庙屋脊与一栋醒目的黄色楼房从灰绿山城中露出。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed in Jiufen, New Taipei, where tightly packed homes climb the hillside and a temple roof and vivid yellow building emerge from the gray-green townscape.

items.title: 九份灯笼巷
items.description: 拍摄于新北九份，红灯笼沿陡斜阶梯一路向下，茶楼、屋檐与远处海色被收进狭窄街巷。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed in Jiufen, New Taipei, where red lanterns descend a steep stairway between teahouses and tiled roofs, with a glimpse of the sea beyond the narrow lane.

items.title: 九份老街入口
items.titleEn: At the Entrance to Jiufen Old Street
items.description: 拍摄于新北九份老街入口，红白路牌落在店铺与来往人群之间，山城街道从这里向坡上展开。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed at the entrance to Jiufen Old Street in New Taipei, where the red-and-white sign stands among shops and passing visitors as the hillside town rises beyond.

items.title: 十分铁道边的店铺
items.description: 拍摄于新北十分老街，湿润铁轨从两排店铺之间弯向远处，天灯与游客让狭窄街面保持热闹。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed on Shifen Old Street in New Taipei, where wet railway tracks curve between two rows of shops as sky lanterns and visitors animate the narrow lane.

items.title: 铁道边放天灯
items.titleEn: Releasing a Sky Lantern by the Tracks
items.description: 拍摄于新北十分老街，游客在铁道旁托起写满祝愿的天灯，店铺、轨道与围观人群贴得很近。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed on Shifen Old Street in New Taipei, where visitors raise a sky lantern covered with wishes beside tracks pressed closely between shops and onlookers.

items.title: 十分站前的列车
items.description: 拍摄于新北十分老街，一列黄色区间车贴着铁道两侧的人群缓慢驶过，街道与铁路短暂让出同一条通道。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed on Shifen Old Street in New Taipei, where a yellow local train moves slowly past crowds standing close to both sides of the track.

items.title: 驶入十分老街的列车
items.titleEn: A Train Entering Shifen Old Street
items.description: 拍摄于新北十分老街，列车沿雨后铁轨从绿意与民居之间驶来，店铺门前的警示灯已经亮起。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed on Shifen Old Street in New Taipei, where a train approaches along rain-darkened tracks between greenery and homes as warning lights glow beside the shops.

items.title: 水雾中的十分瀑布
items.description: 拍摄于新北十分瀑布，宽阔水幕从岩壁倾泻而下，升起的水雾把右侧山林罩上一层薄纱。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed at Shifen Waterfall in New Taipei, where a broad curtain of water drops over the rock face and rising spray veils the forest beside it.

items.title: 台北车站旁的招牌街景
items.description: 拍摄于台北车站M8出口附近，密集商号与补习班招牌层层挂在旧楼立面上，路口人车从下方穿过。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed near Exit M8 of Taipei Main Station, where dense shop and cram-school signs cover older facades above the traffic and pedestrians at the junction.

items.title: 阴天里的台北101
items.description: 拍摄于台北信义区，从近处仰望台北101，层叠玻璃幕墙与外挑结构在均匀阴天里显出清晰线条。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed in Taipei's Xinyi District, looking up at Taipei 101 as its layered glass facade and projecting forms stand sharply against an even gray sky.

items.title: 台北故宫里的翠玉白菜
items.titleEn: The Jadeite Cabbage at the National Palace Museum
items.description: 拍摄于台北国立故宫博物院，翠玉白菜在展柜灯光下显出由白到绿的天然色层与细密叶脉。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed at the National Palace Museum in Taipei, where the Jadeite Cabbage reveals its natural white-to-green layers and finely carved veins beneath the display lighting.

items.title: 圆山大饭店的红阶
items.titleEn: Red Stairs at the Grand Hotel
items.description: 拍摄于台北圆山大饭店，大红立柱、地毯台阶与雕龙石栏在大堂灯光下交错出鲜明层次。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed inside Taipei's Grand Hotel, where red columns and carpeted stairs intersect with carved dragon balustrades beneath the lobby lights.

items.title: 蓝调时刻的士林市场
items.description: 拍摄于台北士林夜市，直立的士林市场招牌在蓝调天空下亮起，摊档灯光与人群从老街入口向内延伸。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed at Shilin Night Market in Taipei, where the vertical market sign glows beneath a blue-hour sky and stall lights lead into the crowded old street.

items.title: 士林夜市的香肠摊
items.titleEn: Sausages on the Grill at Shilin Night Market
items.description: 拍摄于台北士林夜市，不同口味的香肠整齐铺在烤架上，摊位风扇把炭火热气吹向一侧。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed at Shilin Night Market in Taipei, where rows of sausages in different flavors cover the grill as a small fan pushes the heat aside.

items.title: 华灯初上的士林夜市
items.description: 拍摄于台北士林夜市，天色刚暗，密集小吃招牌与店灯已经亮起，人群沿狭窄街道向深处涌入。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed at Shilin Night Market in Taipei just after dusk, as dense food signs and shop lights come on and crowds move deeper into the narrow street.

items.title: 夕阳下的圆山大饭店
items.titleEn: The Grand Hotel in Evening Light
items.description: 拍摄于台北圆山大饭店，夕阳从侧面照亮红柱、金瓦与层叠飞檐，主楼在蓝天下显得格外鲜明。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed at Taipei's Grand Hotel, where evening light catches the red columns, golden roof, and layered eaves, setting the main building sharply against the blue sky.

items.title: 圆山长廊的落日
items.titleEn: Sunset Along the Grand Hotel Corridor
items.description: 拍摄于台北圆山大饭店，落日从长廊尽头照进来，金光沿栏杆与檐下延伸，远处城区沉入剪影。
items.descriptionEn: Photographed at Taipei's Grand Hotel, where the setting sun enters from the end of the corridor and runs along the railings and eaves above a silhouetted city.
